text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
AD-DUSTOUR
- King Hussein may visit Israel tomorrow. Trip to United States delayed. Prominent Israeli figures praise the king.
- King Hussein appoints Mohammad Kailani to head investigation into Baqoura killing.
- Officials say no indication of political motive in shooting of Israelis, mother of soldier says he mentally ill.
AL-RAI
- Israeli president praises King Hussein's handling of Baqoura shooting.
- Daqamsa tribe send message to King Hussein denouncing attack on Israelis.
- Crown Prince Hassan confirms importance of achieving peace for Arabs and Israelis. Says Jordan rejects the policy of changing facts on the ground in Jerusalem.
- Royal decree approves appointment of 11 judges and prosecutors.
- Prime minister delays planned visit to UAE.
- Jordan-Turkey talks begin in Ankara on sales of Turkish water to Jordan.
- Saudi industry minister arrives in Jordan to open Saudi-Jordanian industrial exhibition.
AL-ASWAQ
- Daqamsa tribe condemn shooting of Israelis by one of their number, embrace leadership of King Hussein.
- Sources say Royal Jordanian airline to announce on Sunday a capital raise to 220 million dinars ($310 million) as part of plans to move airline into private sector.
JORDAN TIMES
- King to visit families of Baqoura attack.
- Assailant was loner with psychological problems.
- Attack was an isolated incident and does not reflect Jordan's policy or the conduct of its armed forces, crown prince says.
- Jordanians to be airlifted from Albania.
